title: Graciela Domínguez, Virtual Interim Governor of Sinaloa, Is an Honest Woman, Sheinbaum Says
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz originally appeared in
the[August 25, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/08/25/politica/graciela-
dominguez-virtual-gobernadora-interina-de-sinaloa-es-una-mujer-honesta-dice-
sheinbaum), Mexico's premier left-wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Even though the appointment of federal deputy Graciela
Domínguez as interim governor of Sinaloa was not yet formal, though very
likely, President Claudia Sheinbaum commented that she is an honest woman,
served as the state's education secretary, and has spent many years fighting
for social justice. She mentioned that she does know her, though she did not
elaborate further.

> I am just finding out that they chose her to be governor. She must be
> supported in whatever she needs, for the government and people of Sinaloa.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

Nevertheless, she stressed that this was a decision of the Congress and not of
the president. **From what she knows, "she is a woman who has the capacity to
carry out the work," one who conducts herself with integrity and will be
important during the electoral process to choose the new governor.**

She objected to the people of Sinaloa being stigmatized, since they are very
hardworking.

At 50 years old, Graciela Domínguez Nava has a political career spanning
approximately 35 years and has held various public offices in Sinaloa, among
them secretary of Public Education and Culture of the state government, a
responsibility she held before arriving at the Chamber of Deputies.

She holds a degree in Sociology from the Faculty of Philosophy and Letters of
the Autonomous University of Sinaloa (UAS), and her career combines
legislative experience, public administration, and party activity.
